text.headline: Knoxville Coffee Crawl
text.text:
Five of the highest-rated coffee shops near UT and downtown Knoxville, from study spots on the Strip to riverside lattes in South Knoxville.

The stops run in order, moving outward from campus. Ratings are from Google Maps as of November 2026.

text.headline: Capybara Coffee
text.text:
Tucked into University Commons, Capybara Coffee is about a five-minute walk from campus. Sadly, there are no real capybaras, but the vibes are adorable and the coffee is excellent.

Address: 2457 University Commons Way
Rating: 4.8/5 on Google Maps (Nov. 2026)

text.headline: New Here Coffee
text.text:
Right beneath The Hub apartments on the Strip, New Here is just a street away from campus and one of the best study spots in town.

Address: 1915 Cumberland Ave.
Rating: 4.2/5 on Google Maps (Nov. 2026)

text.headline: Coffee 360
text.text:
In the heart of Fort Sanders, Coffee 360 serves a wide variety of flavors and baked goods, a convenient stop for students who live off campus. It also partners with local apartment complexes on monthly “Bagel Socials.”

Rating: 4.7/5 on Google Maps (Nov. 2026)

text.headline: Jacks
text.text:
On Gay Street at the edge of the Old City, Jacks has a vibe unlike any other coffee shop in the area. Along with coffee, it sells plants and other fun goods, and it has a second location on North Central Street.

Address: 133 S. Gay St.
Rating: 4.4/5 on Google Maps (Nov. 2026)

text.headline: Honeybee Coffee Co.
text.text:
Take a short trip across the river into South Knoxville and you’ll find Honeybee Coffee Co., one of the best coffee shops outside of downtown. On top of great coffee, it has views of the river and a large lounge to enjoy your latte in. Hours have changed recently, so check before you go.

Address: 700 Sevier Ave.
Rating: 4.5/5 on Google Maps (Nov. 2026)
